">[代码等价写法] widowGo1.py 1344–1350；s=(半径,pitch,yaw)，此s不是论文状态s_t</p><details><summary>查看 LaTeX 源码</summary><pre>u=\operatorname{clip}\left(\frac{\mathrm{timer}}{\mathrm{traj\_timesteps}},0,1\right),\quad s^{\rm cmd}=(1-u)s^{\rm start}+u s^{\rm goal},\quad p^{\rm cmd}=\operatorname{sphere2cart}(s^{\rm cmd})</pre></details></div><p>[代码步骤] <a href="https://github.com/MarkFzp/Deep-Whole-Body-Control/blob/8159e4ed8695b2d3f62a40d2ab8d88205ac5021a/legged_gym/legged_gym/envs/widowGo1/widowGo1.py#L1316-L1342">widowGo1.py:1316–1342</a>：新start取旧goal，抽新goal，沿球坐标轨迹取有限样点检查包围盒／地底，最多10次重采样。运动时长1–3s、保持0.5–2s；timer超过轨迹总时长才换目标。不能把球坐标lerp说成笛卡尔直线，也不能把有限采样筛选说成连续碰撞安全证明。</p><p>[代码与论文差异] 当前pitch上限π/5，Table2为2π/5；姿态delta三个采样范围全0，<a href="https://github.com/MarkFzp/Deep-Whole-Body-Control/blob/8159e4ed8695b2d3f62a40d2ab8d88205ac5021a/legged_gym/legged_gym/envs/widowGo1/widowGo1_config.py#L63-L71">widowGo1_config.py:63–71</a>。<a href="https://github.com/MarkFzp/Deep-Whole-Body-Control/blob/8159e4ed8695b2d3f62a40d2ab8d88205ac5021a/legged_gym/legged_gym/envs/widowGo1/widowGo1.py#L1308-L1313">widowGo1.py:1308–1313</a> 是逐Euler分量采样后加底盘yaw，而主文写SO(3)均匀采样。当前默认路径显然不能解释为实现了论文的均匀SO(3)采样。</p><h3 id="module-pd">3.6 PD与部署：网络输出不是最后的电机力矩</h3><p><strong>[论文·设计动机]</strong> §2（PDF3）选择腿臂统一的关节空间位置控制，明确联系到自碰撞学习和仿真现实差距。PD将关节目标转成控制力矩；论文没有证明任意网络输出经过PD就稳定安全。</p><figure id="fig-deployment"><img src="data:image/png;base64,
